progression.narrative: The performance opens on D4 and dwells most on D in Phrase 1. Phrase 2 (0:19.3) introduces G, D, Ek, centred on D. Phrase 4 (0:47.3) introduces Gk, centred on G. Phrase 5 (2:14.2) introduces Bb, Fs, centred on G. Phrase 6 (2:42.5) introduces A, centred on G. Phrase 9 (3:53.0) introduces F, centred on D. Phrase 14 (6:27.9) introduces C, centred on Bk. The line peaks at C5 (506.3 Hz) at 7:07.6. It closes on the tonic (C5 → Bb4 → G4 → Gk4 → G4 → G4).
